startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: The She Code Africa chapters API. Start on page 1 - the Actor finds the remaining pages itself.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages the crawler fetches. There are about 5 pages of chapters, so 20 is plenty.

resultsLimit.title: Results limit
resultsLimit.description: Maximum number of chapters to save. Leave empty to save all of them (about 46).
